title: ANAC Regulatory Capture — Revolving Door Between Regulator and Regulated Industry (Juliano Noman ANAC→ABEAR Transition)
incident_timestamp_display: December 2024 – December 2025 (Noman transition and complaint dismissal). Key date: 3 December 2025 (ANAC dismissal of NUP 50001.115849/2025‑10)
allegation_summary: In December 2024, Juliano Noman left the presidency of ANAC to become President of ABEAR (Associação Brasileira das Empresas Aéreas), whose members include LATAM Airlines. This revolving‑door transition occurred while passenger Leandro Disconzi’s formal complaint (NUP 50001.115849/2025‑10) against LATAM was actively pending before ANAC. Subsequently, on 3 December 2025, ANAC dismissed the complaint claiming lack of jurisdiction. The movement of a top regulator to lead the industry association of the airline under investigation constitutes regulatory capture, undermining ANAC’s independence and violating the constitutional principles of legality, morality, and efficiency (CF/88 Art. 37), the administrative principles of Law 9.784/99 (Art. 2), and the objectives of the National Consumer Policy (CDC Art. 4). This structural conflict of interest directly compromised the impartiality of the regulatory process that adversely affected the Brazilian consumer.
